overall: MARGINAL overall: five grounds are GOOD (Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Decabobo, Panlaitan), the east side is POOR and Nangalao is VERY POOR
limiterDetail: The main limiter is a wind and current combination: east wind (Nangalao 20–23 kt, Cabunlawan/Decabaitot 19–23 kt, Barangonan 18–22 kt, Ciron 16–21 kt) on the east side, and current of 1.0–1.4 kt now at Culion, Linapacan, Alava, Decabaitot and Barangonan. Rain is light, 0.0–0.5 mm/h (Barangonan peaks about 0.5 mm/h overnight).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR. No gale, wind signal or heavy-rain warning matching Calamian / MIMAROPA in the recent feed (a distant tropical cyclone alert is listed). See the PAGASA site.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since the morning digest (6:20 AM)
items: Wed 11 and Thu 12 got windier and the supply outlook tightened. Regional wind for both days is now 16 kt with gusts of 22–23 (was 14 kt, gusts 20–21), so Thu 12 moves from slightly soft to soft and Fri 13 follows. Fishing right now is 5 GOOD / 2 MARGINAL / 8 POOR / 1 VERY POOR (was 5 GOOD / 5 MARGINAL / 5 POOR / 1 VERY POOR): Culion, Linapacan, Alava and Binudac slipped from MARGINAL to POOR because current rose to 0.9–1.2 kt.

East side wind is still 16–23 kt for the next 24h, and a strong current pulse (1.5–2.4 kt) is due about 11 PM–5 AM Tuesday at Decabaitot, Alava, Barangonan, Culion and Binudac. PAGASA shows no warning for Palawan. Shortage detector ELEVATED Mon–Sat; surge OFF.

shortageRisk: Surge flag OFF. The shortage detector is ELEVATED for Mon–Sat (guide only). Tightening risk is high around Thu 12–Fri 13 arrivals after the two windy days. Lean on Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan and Decabobo for supply.

bestWindow.headline: Tonight about 11 PM–5 AM at Decabobo, Tara and Turda; this afternoon at Coron and Galoc
details: Decabobo: about 11 PM (wind 2.2 kt, current 0.0) and about 5 AM (1.4 kt, current 0.0).
